Prioritize Workers & Pages for all new applications. Use the official `wrangler` CLI for project scaffolding and deployment. Always start with `wrangler generate`.
npx wrangler generate my-worker --type=module --ts
npx create-cloudflare@latest my-fullstack-app --framework next

For multiple apps, use `pnpm` or `yarn workspaces`. Manage secrets securely via `wrangler.toml` or the Cloudflare dashboard. Use `.dev.vars` for local development.
dotenv -e .dev.vars -- npx prisma migrate dev

Avoid in-memory state that needs to persist across requests or instances. Use KV, D1, or Durable Objects as appropriate; use Hyperdrive for existing regional databases. Always use R2 for large file storage. Use `cloudflared` for secure access.
cloudflared tunnel create Azure-01

Keep Worker bundles as small as possible. Tree-shake dependencies aggressively. Use Prisma with `engineType: "client"` and an edge-compatible driver adapter. All I/O operations *must* be `await`ed. Always configure WAF, Bot Fight Mode, and Rate Limiting. Use `Vitest` or `Jest` and `Miniflare`; deploy staging in CI/CD and test full flows.
npx wrangler deploy --env staging
npx playwright test --project=staging
